title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Completion of a Calibration Order
content:
An ADAS Sensor Calibrations order completes in-house when every procedure in the tier's procedures has a passed attempt, the post-calibration scan is clean where the tier requires a post-calibration scan, and the verification road test of the tier's road-test miles is done. A sublet order completes when the dealer's report and invoice are received.

**Condition for completion.** Every procedure of the tier has a passed attempt on the order, or the dealer's report is received for a sublet. The condition is read from the attempts recorded on that same order — the procedure each attempt ran and its result.

**On completion.** The calibration report goes to the payer and the customer within the tier's report delivery hours and is kept for the tier's report retention years, a calibration certificate is issued where the tier issues one, and the warranty plan the tier names is issued.

## Truth table: in-house completion of a tier whose procedures are static and dynamic

| Passed static attempt on the order | Passed dynamic attempt on the order | Every procedure of the tier passed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |
| yes | no | no |
| no | yes | no |
| no | no | no |

For a tier with a single procedure, one passed attempt of that procedure satisfies the condition.

## Points of judgement

- A failed attempt followed by a passed attempt of the same procedure leaves that procedure with a passed attempt.
- For a sublet order, the condition is met by the receipt of the dealer's report; completion itself also needs the dealer's invoice.
